name: War-Awoken Blazing Nova (Weapon Skill)

effects:
Single-target Fire/Earth/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Fire/Earth Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/3 En-Fire/Earth

WS Gold: Instant Physical to all allies
